title: BoardPrep Batch650 LET source-first production expansion

official_scope_check.fresh_prc_check: No newer controlling LEPT exam-area, weight, specialization-scope, TOS, or licensure-structure source was found; 2026 PRB resolutions listed as current are registration-without-examination actions and 2026 schedule amendments are testing-center/date administration.

selected_leaves.family_evidence: The five existing leaf items cover one-output validity, table/rule translation, equivalent representations, input/output distinction, and relation validity; none evaluates a stated rule numerically.
The existing five items ask learners to identify, test, represent, or reject a pattern rule; none computes a specified later term from an explicit sequence.

The five existing items address complementary/supplementary angles, a linear pair, checking a shared vertex/line, and justifying a basic relationship; alternate-interior congruence for parallel lines is not among their tested propositions.
The five existing items address fraction operations, comparison, numerator/denominator meaning, ratio order, and range checking; none determines a fractional part of a counted set.

The five existing items cover defining unknowns, choosing a rate relation, checking reasonableness, stating assumptions, and interpreting a computed result; none solves a fixed-plus-variable cost model.
The existing five leaf items calculate means, medians, or a total from a supplied mean; none interprets how a single extreme observation affects the choice of a typical-value measure.

The five existing questions classify as interpretation or analysis and none asks the learner to revise agreement for a gerund phrase functioning as subject; this applies the leaf through a distinct sentence-editing family.

wave2_gate.why_bounded: Seven per-leaf semantic reviews demonstrated one remaining source-supported high-value family each: one General Education editing family and six Mathematics specialization families. The remaining under-10 deficit is not a quota; unreviewed candidate leaves require fresh item-level family evidence, while ProfEd and shared REVIEW candidates remain blocked.

unselected_priority_candidates.reason: The exact Wave1 item already exercises pronoun agreement with a compound antecedent. Existing evidence did not establish a distinct remaining high-value family beyond that proposition, so its remaining numerical headroom was not treated as authoring permission.

gened.limitations: Counts use the permanent component placements; readiness remains leaf-scoped.

profed.limitations: Batch649 source/currentness review remains blocking; no Batch650 authoring was performed.
